message: EMAIL-1 slice 3: first mailbox write path. trash sender rules may IMAP UID MOVE INBOX mail to the server-advertised \Trash only, via MailboxWriterService; gated by MAILBOX_WRITES_ENABLED=true (exact string, fail-closed), refuses servers without MOVE (imapflow would emulate with expunge), verifies UIDVALIDITY+Message-ID, audits in MailboxAction before/after, undo via POST /mailbox-actions/:id/undo restores to INBOX (Gmail labels not re-applied). Apply endpoint is DB-only dry run by default; dryRun=false with writes off is 403.

EMAIL-1 slice 3 hardening: MailboxAction.accountId ON DELETE RESTRICT (audit kept; account delete 409); one active move per message via hand-written partial unique indexes (Prisma 6.19 verified not to drop them); new status unknown + read-only POST /mailbox-actions/reconcile; apply acts only on the winning rule and skips review-overridden mail; never re-trash a Message-ID trashed before; API binds 127.0.0.1 and write endpoints require X-Email-AI-Client header.
